jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager DACH - German speaker
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company specializing in innovative and sustainable packaging solutions. Serving customers across multiple industries, the company is recognized for its technical expertise, customer-centric approach, and commitment to delivering high-quality products tailored to clients' needs.

As part of its continued growth, the company is looking for an Account Manager / Business Development Manager to develop and strengthen its presence across the DACH region (Germany, Austria and Switzerland).

Jobomschrijving

Reporting to the Sales Director, you will be responsible for developing new business opportunities while managing and growing an existing portfolio of customers across the DACH region.

You will act as a trusted partner to your customers, identifying opportunities, providing tailored packaging solutions, and collaborating closely with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and implement a commercial strategy for the DACH market.
• Identify, prospect and acquire new customers across targeted industries.
• Manage and expand an existing portfolio of key accounts.
• Build long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers.
• Understand customer needs and propose customized packaging solutions.
• Lead commercial negotiations and close new business opportunities.
• Prepare quotations in collaboration with internal technical and customer service teams.
• Coordinate projects internally to ensure successful implementation.
• Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer developments.
• Represent the company at customer meetings, trade fairs and industry events.
• Maintain accurate reporting and pipeline management through the CRM system.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 3-5 years of successful B2B sales or business development experience, ideally within packaging, industrial manufacturing, paper, plastics, labels, printing, or another technical environment.
• Experience selling value-added technical solutions is a strong advantage.
• Strong commercial drive with excellent hunting and relationship-building skills.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and autonomous approach.
• Strong negotiation, presentation and communication skills.
• Comfortable working in an international environment with cross-functional teams.
• Willingness to travel regularly throughout the DACH region. (Mainly Germany)
• Fluent in German, French and English
• Based in Eupen or around

jobs.occupation: Account Manager - AI-Powered Digital Solutions - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading European digital agency specialized in the design and development of AI-native digital products (mobiel, web, agents) for customers across different industries.

With over 15 years of experience, the company is now entering a new phase driven by artificial intelligence.

This new model significantly accelerates delivery timelines and reduces costs, positioning the company as a disruptive player in the digital services and software industry.

Jobomschrijving

Business Development & Sales

• Proactively drive new business acquisition in Belgium
• Leverage an existing network and develop new relationships with key decision-makers (C-level, digital, innovation, IT)
• Promote a disruptive value proposition combining AI-powered software and services
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing
• Re-engage existing and past clients with the new AI-driven offering

Market Positioning & Visibility

• Act as a local ambassador for the company's innovative positioning
• Organize and participate in events (afterworks, breakfasts, demos, conferences)
• Collaborate closely with marketing to generate pipeline and visibility
• Create impactful messaging around the company's AI capabilities

Strategic Contribution

• Help define and execute the go-to-market strategy for Belgium
• Provide market feedback to leadership on client needs and positioning
• Contribute to structuring and scaling the future sales organization

Leadership Evolution (Mid-term)

• Build and lead a local commercial team
• Grow revenues

Experience

• Relevant experience in B2B services sales (digital, software, or tech services)
• Experience selling complex or innovative solutions (SaaS, digital services, AI, consulting)
• Proven track record in business development and closing deals
• Background in agencies, digital services companies, or software providers

Mindset & Skills

• "Doer" mentality, hands-on, entrepreneurial, and execution-focused
• Strong appetite for innovation and AI-driven transformation
• Ability to understand and sell disruptive, complex value propositions
• Commercial creativity (events, storytelling, market activation)
• Autonomous, proactive, and comfortable in flat environment

Soft Skills

• Curious and passionate about emerging technologies, especially AI
• Strong communication and influencing skills
• Resilient, driven, and "hungry" for growth opportunities
• Ability to operate in an evolving and fast-changing environment

Languages

• Fluent in French, English
• Excellent knowledge in Dutch

Join an international medical non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting equitable access to resilient healthcare systems worldwide, including in Belgium, with the mission of ensuring that no one suffers or dies from preventable and treatable diseases.

The organisation operates across multiple countries, advancing public health through sustainable healthcare initiatives. It provides expert, compassionate care to people affected by tuberculosis and neglected tropical skin diseases, such as leprosy and leishmaniasis, which are closely associated with poverty, while working in close collaboration with local health systems and communities.

Jobomschrijving

You lead individual donor retention strategy to maximise donor lifetime value and drive sustainable fundraising growth through data-driven donor journeys, strong donor loyalty, and an outstanding donor experience.

Your role ?

1. Individual Donor Retention Strategy

• Define and lead the long-term individual donor retention strategy,
• Own and continuously optimize the donor lifecycle (welcome, engagement, upgrade,loyalty, reactivation).
• Drive donor retention, lifetime value and sustainable individual giving revenue.
• Align retention priorities fundraising objectives

2. Donor Experience & Engagement

• Ensure a consistent, seamless and donor-centric experience across all touchpoints.
• Lead multi-channel donor stewardship and engagement initiatives.
•  Strengthen donor loyalty, advocacy and long-term commitment through personalized engagement.
•  Coordinate stakeholders involved in the donor journey to ensure consistency and impact.

3. Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Define, monitor and report on retention, engagement and lifetime value KPIs.
• Translate donor insights into strategic recommendations and improvement actions.
• Evaluate initiatives and optimize resource allocation based on impact.
• Foster a data-driven culture of continuous improvement.

4. Data-Driven Donor Journeys

• Advance the use of donor data to personalize journeys and improve decision-making
• Partner with ICT and CRM teams to ensure reliable data, segmentation and automation.
• Optimize donor journey processes through data, testing, and technology.
• Ensure donor engagement is supported by accurate, actionable and shared data.

5. Mission-led Donor Communications

• Strengthen the emotional connection between donors and Damien Foundation.
• Shape donor communications together with Brand & Acquisition to maximize engagement and loyalty.
• Ensure storytelling and engagement support long-term donor commitment and sustainable revenue growth.
• Contribute to a coherent donor experience aligned with the organization's positioning.

6. Data Governance & GDPR Compliance

• Ensure all donor engagement, retention, communication, and data management activities comply with GDPR requirements and internal data protection policies. 
• Safeguard donor privacy, consent management, data accuracy, and the secure use of personal data across all channels and systems

• You have a master's degree in marketing, Sales, Economics, Communications, or equivalent experience.
•  You have a minimum of 5 years' experience in donor engagement, individual giving, donor retention, CRM-driven marketing, or customer/donor lifecycle management, with a proven ability to design and optimize data-driven journeys that strengthen loyalty, lifetime value, and long-term support.
•  Experience in the non-profit or social impact sector is an asset.
•  You are fluent in French and Dutch, with professional proficiency in the other national language and excellent written and spoken English.
•  Strong organizational skills, with a focus on efficient processes, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
•  Strong digital mindset, with the ability to support digital transformation and leverage digital tools to achieve strategic objectives.
•  Opportunity-driven, action-oriented, and results-focused, with strong attention to detail and a proven ability to deliver long-term results.
•  Strong leadership, project management and change management skills.
•  Proven people management experience, with the ability to lead and develop teams through organizational transformation while fostering a culture of open communication and collaboration.
•  Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate donor data into actionable insights.
•  Experience with CRM systems, donor segmentation, and marketing automation.
•  Experience with ERP software is an asset .
•  Excellent writing skills and communication skills

Our client is a well-established international organisation with a strong reputation for operational excellence and a people-focused culture.

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.
• Managing incidents, service requests, and technical queries in line with established processes and service level agreements.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.
• Acting as the primary local IT point of contact for employees based in Belgium.

• At least 2/3 years of experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or End User Support role.
• Fluency in English & Dutch. French is a plus. 
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, end-user computing, networking fundamentals, and IT security best practices.
• Experience managing incidents, service requests, and change-related activities.

• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve technical issues independently.
• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.

ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.

On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.
